name: Rottenmeier Golch
original_name: ロッテンマイヤー・ゴルチ
source:
Rottenmeier Golch is a high-class woman from the Helman Empire. Though mentioned in other games, she has so far only made an appearance in the non-canonical Kichikuou Rance.  

She was the wife of one of the members of the Council of Eight, [url=/c97641]Bitch Golch[/url]. She possesses an influential social standing - despite holding no official position, she is able to order around the guards of Volgo Z prison. Only high ranking soldiers dare defy her due to her political influence. 

Like the other members of her family, she spends most of her time enjoying brutish pleasures and maintains a high opinion of herself, despite not demonstrating any actual ability. Her real passion is torture. She loves taking young girls, preferably beautiful ones, and slowly tormenting them in her mansion until they go insane. Her tastes are well known among Helman prisons, with even the harsh guards seeing her as something of a monster. She's an experienced torturer, never accidentally causing lethal wounds on her victims; any that find their way into her possession always die in fits of hysteria.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Rottenmeier_Golch]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
